description: This file defines classes and functions for VRB-to-PRB resource mapping in 5G NR (New Radio) resource allocation, including configurations for interleaved and non-interleaved mappings, and factory functions for creating specific configurations based on 3GPP TS38.211 specifications.

classes.name: non_interleaved_mapping
classes.description: Class for handling VRB-to-PRB mapping in non-interleaved mode, providing conversion methods between VRB and PRB representations.

classes.name: interleaved_mapping
classes.description: Class for handling VRB-to-PRB mapping in interleaved mode, providing conversion methods between VRB and PRB representations.

methods.name: vrb_to_prb
methods.description: Converts a VRB index to its corresponding PRB index.

methods.name: prb_to_vrb
methods.description: Converts a PRB index to its corresponding VRB index.

methods.name: vrb_to_prb
methods.description: Converts a VRB interval to its corresponding PRB interval.

methods.name: prb_to_vrb
methods.description: Converts a PRB interval to its corresponding VRB interval.

methods.name: vrb_to_prb
methods.description: Converts a VRB bitmap to a PRB bitmap.

methods.name: prb_to_vrb
methods.description: Converts a PRB bitmap to a VRB bitmap.

methods.name: vrb_to_crb
methods.description: Converts a VRB bitmap to a CRB bitmap.

methods.name: vrb_to_crb_indices
methods.description: Returns CRB indices corresponding to VRB bitmap.
